description:
Mostly mechanical once the skeleton is proven. Grouped because individually these are too small to be epics.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- OAuth flows (Anthropic first; GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex to follow).
- Cost tracking (per-provider pricing table; accumulate usage per session).
- Context compaction (`session_before_compact` hook + summarization logic).
- Retry + rate-limit handling across providers.
- Permission-prompt polish for risky tools (bash commands, file writes outside cwd).

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.1 (OAuth), §6 Phase 8.
title: Phase 8: polish — OAuth, cost tracking, compaction
